bullets.text: AI-Powered Paint Update - **Microsoft** introduces Restyle feature in Paint for Windows Insiders, enhancing image transformation capabilities.
Windows 11 Build Release - **Microsoft** rolls out Build 22631.6132 to Release Preview Channel, addressing touch keyboard issues.
Cybersecurity Insights - **Microsoft** highlights urgent need for resilience in response to accelerating cyberthreats in latest report.
New Windows Builds - **Microsoft** releases Windows 11 Builds 26100.7015 and 26200.7015, featuring UI enhancements and new settings.
AI Applications Evolution - **Microsoft** emphasizes the importance of continuous learning in AI applications for enhanced productivity.
Unified Security Platform - **Microsoft** launches Security Store, a hub for AI-powered security solutions and partnerships.
Holiday Tech Gifts - **Microsoft** promotes innovative products for the holiday season, enhancing creativity and connectivity.
Azure SQL Migration Success - **Microsoft** showcases how organizations improve efficiency by migrating to Azure SQL.
Blob Storage Threats - **Microsoft** outlines unique threats targeting Azure Blob Storage and recommends security measures.
Windows Insider Preview - **Microsoft** announces Insider Preview Build 26220.6972, featuring new mobile device management settings.
